name: checkbox
gotchas: `indeterminate` is a purely visual state — a user click always resolves the box to `checked = true`, it never becomes a genuine third bound value. Clear `indeterminate` yourself in the `(change)` handler if you're using it for a tri-state parent checkbox.

Reactive-forms-bound checkboxes should bind `formControlName`/`[formControl]` rather than combining `[checked]` and `(change)` on the same element — mixing both patterns makes the control's value and the DOM checkbox state fight each other.

On an `OnPush` component, toggling a plain (non-form) boolean bound to `[checked]` from outside a DOM event (e.g. a timer or subscription) needs an explicit change-detection trigger, or the checkbox visually never updates.
